instructions: Does this class place domain behaviour in the component that owns it? Scene roots should coordinate; child components should own movement, combat and other domain behaviour. Prefer composition and explicit contracts. Judge only concrete ownership violations evidenced by the supplied code and any supplied project rules.

criteria.cohesive: Responsibilities belong to this class or it coordinates its collaborators.
criteria.misplaced_behaviour: Concrete domain behaviour is implemented by a coordinator or unrelated owner.
criteria.insufficient_context: The ownership contract or collaborating components are missing.
